title: Macron Hosts 37-Nation Coalition of the Willing Summit for Ukraine
detail: President Macron co-chaired a summit of the Coalition of the Willing at the Hôtel national des Invalides in Paris alongside UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, joined by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and NATO Secretary General. Leaders from 37 countries committed to supporting Ukraine militarily took stock of operational planning for post-war security guarantees and intensified pressure on Russia's war effort, including action against the sanctions-evading "ghost fleet" tanker network. The gathering built on the Paris Declaration of January 6, 2026 and preceded Macron's Bastille Day parade the following day, at which several coalition leaders were guests of honor.

title: France and Ukraine Sign Deal for Initial Batch of 16 Rafale Fighter Jets
detail: President Macron and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky signed a bilateral defense roadmap in Paris covering the first tranche of a planned 100-jet Rafale fleet for Ukraine, building on the November 2025 letter of intent. The initial batch of 16 Rafale multirole fighters is scheduled for delivery around 2028–2029, bundled with next-generation SAMP/T NG air-defense batteries, radar networks, and industrial licenses letting Ukraine domestically produce SCALP-EG cruise missiles, Aster 30 interceptors, and AASM precision-guided bombs. Training of Ukrainian pilots and mechanics in France is set to begin in the coming months. The signing came alongside the Coalition of the Willing summit hosted the same day in Paris.
